item.description:

The New York City Department of Social Services (DSS) has adopted a new citywide approach to the Department of Homeless Services (DHS) response during Code Blue and Code Red weather emergencies. The new zone-based deployment model is designed to provide more consistent and comprehensive outreach coverage across areas with the highest likelihood of unsheltered individuals. Implementation of this model requires additional canvassing capacity beyond current DHS staffing levels. item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
